domains.name: Application
domains.covers: Launching and quitting Premiere Pro, preferences, plug-ins, performance, help and account items.

features.name: Native Apple silicon support
features.summary: The macOS build runs natively on Apple silicon; some third-party plug-ins need Rosetta.

automation.notes: Platform property, not an action.

features.name: Apply changed preferences
features.summary: Notifies the application that preference values were changed so it picks them up.

automation.notes: Used after writing preference keys through app.properties; the keys themselves are undocumented. Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member broadcasts preference changes; AppPreference.setValue is the only preference writer).

features.name: Clear media cache on launch
features.summary: Clearing the media cache while the application starts, for troubleshooting.

automation.notes: Done at start-up from the keyboard; UXP MediaManager.purgeMediaCache covers clearing from a plugin.

features.name: Adobe Creative Cloud Diagnostics
features.summary: Diagnostic tool for crashes and launch problems, run from the Creative Cloud desktop app.

automation.notes: Outside the application.

features.name: DirectX HDR
features.summary: Windows HDR display support for previews on HDR-capable monitors.

features.name: Mercury Playback Engine GPU acceleration
features.summary: Uses the GPU (CUDA, Metal or OpenCL) for effects, rendering and playback; chosen as the renderer in Project Settings.

automation.notes: The renderer is a project setting; no documented ExtendScript or UXP member sets it.

features.name: Hardware-accelerated decoding
features.summary: Uses supported GPU or media engines to decode H.264, HEVC and other codecs for smoother playback.

automation.notes: Set in Media preferences; keys undocumented.

features.name: Hardware encoding
features.summary: Uses hardware encoders for H.264 and HEVC exports when the system supports them.

automation.notes: Chosen per export in the encoding settings (Performance: Hardware Encoding) or by the export preset; presets can be passed to Encoder.encodeSequence.

features.name: Premiere Pro Help
features.summary: Opens the online user guide.

automation.notes: Opens a browser; nothing to automate.

features.name: Install plugins and extensions
features.summary: Installing third-party effect plug-ins, CEP extensions and UXP plugins, which then appear in the Effects panel or the Window > Extensions or Plugins menus.

automation.notes: Installation is done with Creative Cloud, the UXP Developer Tool or vendor installers; nothing in the object model installs plug-ins.

features.name: Launch Premiere
features.summary: Starting the application, which shows the Start screen or the most recently opened files depending on General preferences.

automation.notes: Launching is done by the operating system; no scripting member starts the application. ExtendScript can only run after launch (see limitations on command-line execution).

features.name: Manage effects and plug-ins
features.summary: Lists installed effect plug-ins and lets them be turned off or on.

automation.notes: No documented scripting member. No UXP member either.

features.name: Media Cache
features.summary: Folder of conformed audio, peak files and indexes, with options to clean it automatically, delete unused files or clear it on launch.

automation.notes: UXP: MediaManager.purgeMediaCache flushes the media cache; the cache location and automatic-deletion options have no member. Needs Premiere Pro 26.5 or later for MediaManager.purgeMediaCache. Earlier record (route unknown): UXP 26.5+: MediaManager.purgeMediaCache. No ExtendScript member. Claimed by clear_media_cache (MediaManager.purgeMediaCache, 26.5). The cache location, automatic deletion of old files and clear-on-launch options have no member.

features.name: Preference file locations

automation.notes: Read-only paths. Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member returns preference file locations).

UXP: AppPreference.getValue/setValue accept only the PreferenceKey constants AUTO_PEAK_GENERATION, IMPORT_WORKSPACE and SHOW_QUICKSTART_DIALOG, which the reference does not describe; none is established as this preference.

features.name: Exit
features.summary: Quits the application, prompting to save any unsaved project changes.

automation.notes: app.quit() prompts to save changed projects, so an unattended call can block on the save prompt. On macOS the item is Premiere > Quit Premiere. Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member quits the application; CloseProjectOptions.setIsAppBeingPreparedToQuit only flags a project close).

features.name: Recover projects after a crash
features.summary: Reopening the auto-saved or crash-saved copy of a project after an unexpected quit.

automation.notes: UXP: Open a file from the Auto-Save folder with Project.open (ScratchDiskSettings.getScratchDiskPath with ScratchDiskFolderType.AUTO_SAVE gives the folder); choosing the right version is up to the caller. ExtendScript: A script can open a file from the Auto-Save folder with app.openDocument; finding the right version is up to the caller. Claimed by recover_project: it lists the project's Auto-Save copies (ScratchDiskSettings.getScratchDiskPath with ScratchDiskFolderType.AUTO_SAVE, or the Adobe Premiere Pro Auto-Save folder beside the project when that is reported symbolically) and opens one with Project.open. The recovery prompt Premiere Pro shows at launch after a crash has no member, and which copy is right is the caller's choice.

features.name: Redo
features.summary: Reapplies the last undone change.

automation.notes: No ExtendScript or UXP member found.

features.name: Reset preferences at launch
features.summary: Holding Alt (Windows) or Option (macOS) while starting restores default preferences; adding Shift also clears the plug-in cache.

automation.notes: Keyboard modifiers at start-up only; nothing in the object model resets preferences.

features.name: Display video on a second monitor
features.summary: Sends full-screen video playback to a second display through Mercury Transmit.

features.name: Adobe ID
features.summary: Menu item named after the signed-in Adobe account, holding the settings sync and account commands.

automation.notes: Account sign-in is not exposed to scripts; Application.userGuid only reads an identifier for the signed-in user.

features.name: Software rendering
features.summary: Renderer option that runs effects and playback on the CPU only.

automation.notes: Project setting; no documented member.

features.name: Sync Settings
features.summary: Uploads or downloads preferences, workspaces and keyboard shortcuts through Creative Cloud.

automation.notes: Depends on Creative Cloud. No documented member.

features.name: System Compatibility Report
features.summary: Checks the computer's operating system, GPU, drivers and hardware against Premiere's requirements and lists problems.

automation.notes: SystemCompatibilityReport.CreateReport(path) writes the report to a file without the dialog. Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member writes the System Compatibility Report).

features.name: Third-party plug-ins and tools
features.summary: Native effect, importer, exporter, transmit and control surface plug-ins built with the Premiere Pro C++ SDK.

automation.notes: Plug-ins are compiled with the C++ SDK; scripts can only use them once installed (for example as effects by match name).

features.name: Undo
features.summary: Reverses the last change.

automation.notes: No ExtendScript member. QE DOM (undocumented): qe.project.undo(), reported by community research. UXP: changes made through Project.executeTransaction become single undo steps. Not reachable through UXP (no member performs Undo; each Project.executeTransaction is one undo step).

features.name: Signed-in user identifier
features.summary: A unique identifier for the Creative Cloud user who is signed in.

automation.notes: Read-only. Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member reads the signed-in user).

features.name: Application version and build
features.summary: The version and build number of the running application.

automation.notes: UXP: Application.version; the server reports the version the plugin reads from require("uxp").host.version. ExtendScript: Read-only. UXP: require("uxp").host.version and host.applicationPath (26.5+).

domains.name: Projects
domains.covers: Projects, bins and the Project panel: project items, metadata, labels, search bins and project settings.

features.name: Auto Save
features.summary: Saves project versions into the Auto-Save folder at an interval, keeping a set number of versions.

automation.notes: Preferences are readable and writable through app.properties (getProperty/setProperty), but the preference keys are not documented. UXP: AppPreference.getValue/setValue. UXP: AppPreference.getValue/setValue accept only the PreferenceKey constants AUTO_PEAK_GENERATION, IMPORT_WORKSPACE and SHOW_QUICKSTART_DIALOG, which the reference does not describe; none is established as this preference. The Auto Save folder itself is a scratch disk (ScratchDiskFolderType.AUTO_SAVE, see projects.scratch_disks).

features.name: Backward compatibility of projects
features.summary: Projects saved in a newer version cannot be opened in older versions; they can be exchanged through XML.

automation.notes: File-format property.

features.name: Bin
features.summary: A folder in the Project panel that groups items; bins can be nested.

automation.notes: UXP: FolderItem (cast from ProjectItem) lists children and creates bins. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: Close All Projects
features.summary: Closes every open project.

automation.notes: UXP: Enumerate open projects through their Project panel views (ProjectUtils.getProjectViewIds, getProjectFromViewId) and close each with Project.close. ExtendScript: Iterate app.projects and close each.

features.name: Close Project
features.summary: Closes the active project, asking to save if it has changes.

automation.notes: UXP: Project.close(CloseProjectOptions); setPromptIfDirty(false) keeps it unattended. ExtendScript: closeDocument(saveFirst, promptIfDirty). UXP: Project.close(CloseProjectOptions).

features.name: Collect Files and Copy to New Location
features.summary: Project Manager mode that copies used media into the destination folder without transcoding.

automation.notes: Not reachable through UXP (the UXP DOM has no Project Manager).

features.name: Consolidate and Transcode
features.summary: Project Manager mode that transcodes used footage to one format (MXF OP1a, DNxHD MXF or QuickTime) matched to sequence, clips or a preset.

automation.notes: Not reachable through UXP (the UXP DOM has no Project Manager).

features.name: Consolidate Duplicates
features.summary: Merges project items that point to the same media into one.

automation.notes: Not reachable through UXP (no UXP member consolidates duplicates).

features.name: Copy projects
features.summary: Duplicating a project file, with or without its media.

automation.notes: Copy with media uses Project Manager (app.projectManager). Not reachable through UXP (the UXP DOM has no Project Manager; Project.saveAs copies the project file without its media).

features.name: Delete bin
features.summary: Removes a bin and everything in it from the project.

automation.notes: UXP: The parent bin's FolderItem.createRemoveItemAction(item) inside a transaction. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: Clear
features.summary: Removes the selected items from the project.

automation.notes: UXP: The parent bin's FolderItem.createRemoveItemAction inside a transaction; Project.deleteSequence for sequences. ExtendScript: deleteAsset is declared in the 24.0 types but not documented in the guide; deleteSequence removes sequences.

features.name: Delete projects
features.summary: Removing a project file and, optionally, its media from disk.

automation.notes: Deleting files happens in the file system, not through the object model.

features.name: Find
features.summary: Searches the project or a sequence for items matching up to two criteria.

automation.notes: UXP: Scripts walk the item tree (FolderItem.getItems) or match media paths with ClipProjectItem.findItemsMatchingMediaPath. ExtendScript: The dialog is modal; scripts walk the item tree instead.

features.name: Freeform View
features.summary: Shows project items as freely arranged thumbnails, with grid alignment and saved layouts.

automation.notes: View mode is not scriptable.

features.name: Hover Scrub
features.summary: Previews a clip in Icon or Freeform view by moving the pointer over it.

automation.notes: UI behaviour only.

features.name: Icon View
features.summary: Shows project items as resizable thumbnails with hover scrub and poster frames.

automation.notes: View mode is not scriptable.

features.name: Import mode
features.summary: Full-screen import view shown for a new project: browse media, collect it in a selection tray, optionally copy it, create a sequence and transcribe automatically.

automation.notes: Interactive view. The same results come from Project.importFiles and Project.createNewSequenceFromClips.

features.name: Target bin for import
features.summary: The bin that receives imported media.

automation.notes: UXP: Project.getInsertionBin reads it and Project.importFiles takes a target bin; no UXP member sets the insertion bin. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: Label

automation.notes: UXP: ProjectItem.createSetColorLabelAction(index) inside a transaction; getColorLabelIndex reads it. ExtendScript: Colour by index (0-15). UXP: createSetColorLabelAction.

features.name: Label colors in sequence tabs

features.name: Link clip data to XMP

automation.notes: No UXP member either.

features.name: Metadata Display

automation.notes: UXP: Metadata.getProjectPanelMetadata and setProjectPanelMetadata read and write the column layout. ExtendScript: The dialog is modal; the members read and write the column layout.

features.name: Overlays

automation.notes: Monitor display option; not scriptable.

features.name: Metadata panel
features.summary: Shows and edits clip, file (XMP) and speech metadata for the selected item.

automation.notes: UXP: Metadata.getXMPMetadata and getProjectMetadata read; createSetXMPMetadataAction and createSetProjectMetadataAction write inside a transaction. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: Metadata schema and properties
features.summary: Defines custom metadata properties and schemas shown in the Metadata panel.

automation.notes: UXP: Metadata.addPropertyToProjectMetadataSchema(name, label, type) with a Constants.MetadataType. ExtendScript: addPropertyToProjectMetadataSchema(name, label, type) adds a field to the private project schema.

features.name: Metadata sets
features.summary: Saved choices of which metadata fields the Metadata panel shows.

features.name: Move items between bins
features.summary: Dragging items into another bin.

automation.notes: UXP: The parent bin's FolderItem.createMoveItemAction(item, newParent) inside a transaction. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: Move projects to another computer
features.summary: Transferring a project and its media, then relinking on the other machine.

automation.notes: Not reachable through UXP (the UXP DOM has no Project Manager; ClipProjectItem.changeMediaFilePath can relink media after a manual move).

features.name: Multiple open projects

automation.notes: UXP: Project.open keeps other projects open; ProjectUtils.getProjectViewIds and getProjectFromViewId list them. ExtendScript: the members in dom_refs.

features.name: New Bin

automation.notes: UXP: FolderItem.createBinAction(name, makeUnique) inside a transaction. ExtendScript: UXP: FolderItem.createBinAction.

features.name: New Project

automation.notes: UXP: Project.createProject(path) creates and opens the project without a dialog. ExtendScript: app.newProject(path) creates and opens the project without the dialog. UXP: Project.createProject(path).

features.name: Project Shortcut
features.summary: Adds a shortcut item that opens another project from inside this one.

automation.notes: No UXP member creates a project shortcut.

features.name: Open bin in new panel
features.summary: Double-clicking a bin opens it in place, in a new tab or in a floating panel depending on General preferences.

automation.notes: Panel layout is not scriptable.

features.name: Open Project

features.name: Overlay Settings

features.name: Clip (project) metadata

features.name: Project panel search

features.name: Project panel selection

features.name: Project Settings

features.name: Properties

automation.notes: No member returns the Properties report; individual values come from metadata and footage interpretation.
